```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

library(VennDiagram)
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")
library(grid)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/PolyclonalCultures/DNAm"
```


```{r}
order_df <- function(d, column, decreasing = F) {return(d[order(d[[column]], decreasing = decreasing),])}
```

```{r}
all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()
```





# IM vs. healthy, only new (EPIC) samples


```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated.RData") )
im_nonim_healthy_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
im_nonim_healthy_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_healthy_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = im_nonim_healthy_results

hyper_cpg = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_antrum_vs_healthy_antrum"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

# Export

Gene/Cpg lists defined above are save to file *Methylation_DM_lists.Rdata*.

```{r}
save(all_hyper_cpg, all_hypo_cpg, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists.Rdata"), compress=T)
```



# Overlaps IM vs. healthy + non-IM vs. healthy

```{r}
sel_comparisons = names(all_hyper_cpg)
```


## Hypermethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
x <- venn.diagram(lapply(all_hyper_cpg[sel_comparisons], function(x) x$Row.names), filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```



## Hypermethylated genes

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
inp <- lapply(all_hyper_cpg[sel_comparisons], function(x) {unique(x$gene_symbol) |> (\(c) c[c!=""])() })
x <- venn.diagram(inp, filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```



## Intersecting hypermethylated genes

```{r}
intersecting_genes = c()
for (n in sel_comparisons) {
  if(length(intersecting_genes) ==0) {
    intersecting_genes = (all_hyper_cpg[[n]] |> subset(!gene_symbol==""))$gene_symbol |> unique()
    next
  } else {
    intersecting_genes = intersect(intersecting_genes, (subset(all_hyper_cpg[[n]], !gene_symbol=="")$gene_symbol) |> unique())
  }
}

intersecting_genes |> sort()

```



## Hypomethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
x <- venn.diagram(lapply(all_hypo_cpg[sel_comparisons], function(x) x$Row.names), filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),

grid.draw(x)
```
